note: Cosmetic Aura catalog shared by client and server. Editions marked native are mintable by the collectibles contract (AURA_EDITIONS in contracts/collectibles/src/lib.rs); a deployment that predates that table mints only polar, moon and gold. `source` says where an edition comes from: chest editions drop from zone chests by entitlement; npc, monster, level and season editions never drop from chests and the contract only mints them for award claims whose id starts with earned:npc:, earned:monster:, earned:level: or earned:season: (CLAIM_ONLY_EDITIONS). Set bonuses are visual only and never change GOLD, XP, rewards or odds.
